sources.name: Musicca
sources.permission: Project owner explicitly confirmed permission for percussion reuse on 2026-09-28. Copyright remains with Musicca; this is not a public license.

notes: Recorded drums, hand percussion and genuine tabla bols. Freesound files are public high-quality MP3 previews; tabla variants are not claimed to be systematic velocity layers. VCSL hand drums include recorded dynamics and muted conga/bongo strokes. Existing Musicca and Studio-kit recordings are unchanged. Calibrated voices align their onset and balance levels at playback. No source application code or Soundsnap audio is included.
